chunks.text: Customers must retain the order reference for collection.

Check the completed order before leaving the counter.
Report missing copies or visible printing defects to staff.
The assistant provides an estimate and does not upload, inspect, or print a document.
Provide the page count, number of copies, colour mode, and single-sided or double-sided preference.

Printing is charged per printed side, not per sheet.
Double-sided printing reduces paper use but does not reduce the printing charge in this exercise.

Optional binding costs INR 30 per copy.
Each copy is printed and bound separately.
The print shop accepts documents with a declared page count.

Black-and-white printing costs INR 2 per printed side.
Colour printing costs INR 8 per printed side.

Single-sided printing uses one sheet per document page.
Double-sided printing uses one sheet for every two pages, rounded upward for each copy.
